source_checks.conclusion: target_returned_sample_count counts only exact anchor-bound samples returned by the current query. Empty returns do not imply no global history. Actual frozen query supplies at most last10 samples; it never concatenates risk fragments.

Age is derived only when returned last sample exactly matches the queried anchor. Fit span is defined only for actual WLS_LINEAR_TIME and uses the same returned window supplied to the unmodified last10 DS1 fit; no synthetic time or current-q sample enters pre.

Each field splits finite/missing/nonfinite denominators; usable flags are separately counted. A finite current scale may still fail whole/core mixture or source quality. Forecast.usable is the raw prediction flag, and does not imply passing DS32 forecast<=60 or full query veto eligibility.

Residual and threshold come only from values actually computed in frozen query. Early exits keep them missing, and ratio exists only when both are defined and threshold>0; no inferred residual or selected layer is substituted.

Min/q25/median/q75/max summarize defined finite query-weighted values; all queries and original-eligible queries use separate phase/reason denominators. They are descriptive distributions, not confidence bounds, physical depth accuracy or unique-event samples.

Wrong/correct/unscorable original accepted-action followup receives the same query numeric fields when a real corresponding query exists; absent queries remain None. No pooled unrelated candidate statistic substitutes for these actions.
Helper remains postseal only. Existing single-edge CF, actual bank versus original reference, full switch coverage and weak-reference boundaries are preserved; no prediction/scoring rule is edited.
